name: Furious Blade
description: The weapon moves with predatory zeal: adds one die to a single attack per mote spent, up to double the Dexterity + Melee pool.

name: Savage Shade Style
description: Focuses fury and Essence through the weapon to strike rending blows: successes count twice for determining damage. Must be invoked before the attack roll.

name: Artful Maiming Onslaught
description: Aims to sever limbs: adds Dexterity to damage, but the attack is difficulty 3+ (severing an arm/leg is difficulty 3 and needs 2 health levels after soak; a hand or eye is difficulty 4 and needs 1). The strike inflicts only the minimum levels needed for the maiming; victims still suffer bleeding, shock, doubled wound penalty until stanched, and a reflexive Stamina + Resistance roll to act on the turn they lose a limb.

name: Slashing Ghost Talon
description: The blade shrieks and becomes a conduit for hunger: the Abyssal regains 1 mote of Essence per health level of damage inflicted (soulsteel weapons also absorb motes stolen from an Essence-pooled attuned victim).

name: Crimson Banquet Method
description: Harvests power from every bloodletting blow: duplicates Slashing Ghost Talon's Essence gain for every attack made during the scene (cannot stack with itself or be used alongside Slashing Ghost Talon). Cannot gain more Essence in a turn than Essence + Lore.

name: Soul-Searing Blow
description: Projects the spiritual cold of Oblivion through the weapon to assault soul and will: if the attack hits (it need not inflict damage) the victim loses 1 temporary Willpower per 2 motes spent. Reducing temporary Willpower below zero inflicts 2L per point below (soaked only by permanent Essence). Cannot spend more motes than twice Conviction.

name: Reaper of Men
description: Suffuses body and weapon with necrotic Essence: any living being who touches or strikes her hand-to-hand suffers lethal damage equal to her Essence, and her own hand-to-hand attacks inflict lethal and add Essence to damage. Mindless ghosts and walking dead will not attack her unless compelled.

name: Soul-Cleaving Strike
description: The weapon flares with cold fire and shrieks for a mile. One attack at full pool that is fully effective against material AND incorporeal targets and does normal damage plus this effect: if it hits, the victim rolls permanent Essence at standard difficulty; success means unsoakable lethal damage equal to the Abyssal's Essence, failure loses one dot of permanent Essence, a botch inflicts both. Essence to zero snuffs the life force. Purely spiritual damage; no effect on soulless beings or automata.

name: Five Shadow Feint
description: The arm and weapon flicker into a confusing spray of shadows: the target loses one die from her first defensive pool per mote spent (not below the Abyssal's Essence). Comboed with Furious Blade, both Charms cost 2 motes per die.

name: Ebon Lightning Prana
description: Draws and strikes faster than mortal eyes can follow: no penalty for drawing a sheathed weapon and he strikes regardless of initiative. His first action must be a Melee attack, and he can take no other dice actions until his regular initiative. Once per turn; the weapon must be sheathed to use it.

name: Unfurling Iron Lotus
description: Spins and thrusts in a rapid cascade of blows: one additional attack at full pool per 3 motes spent (no more extra attacks than Essence). Activated before the first action; the pool cannot be split that turn, and defenders must dodge or parry each attack separately.

name: Glorious Carnage Typhoon
description: Scythes through opponents like a tornado: so long as she hits her target and inflicts damage she may immediately attack another victim at full pool, moving no more than her Melee score between targets. Ends when she misses or strikes every possible victim in reach.

name: Blade-Summoning Gesture
description: Extends will and anima in a grasping tendril to call his weapon to hand. Summoned weapons overcome friction and gravity (even pulling free of bodies) but cannot defeat walls or chains; he must see the weapon and have a free hand, and may only call weapons he has previously wielded.

name: Thieving Raiton Claws
description: Steals a foe's weapon: reach out an empty hand, roll Dexterity + Melee at difficulty 3 (cannot be parried or dodged); success resolves as a disarm and the weapon flies to the Abyssal's grasp. Works on any weapon in line of sight except magical weapons attuned to their wielders or weapons made entirely of Essence.

name: Void Sheath Technique
description: Banishes a weapon Elsewhere, hidden and inaccessible until the character reflexively ends the Charm and draws it forth. Only one weapon at a time, one the Abyssal is intimately familiar with.

name: Resplendent Shadow Blade
description: Freezes raw Essence into an ideal weapon of black crystal (any bladed form). The player divides twice the Melee score among the weapon's Speed/Damage/Accuracy/Defense; its damage bonus adds to Strength for base lethal damage. The blade has the tensile strength of soulsteel and drains motes equal to the owner's Essence on any hit that inflicts damage. Re-buy to conjure a different form.

name: Elegant Flowing Deflection
description: Shifts the weapon to parry any hand-to-hand attack he is aware of: rolls two dice per mote spent (not more than his normal defensive pool), including specialties and weapon bonuses. An odd remaining half-mote is lost.

name: Vengeful Riposte
description: Parries an incoming strike with a blow to the attacker's weapon hand or limb; leftover successes beyond the attacker's become a Melee attack against the aggressor that cannot be blocked or dodged without magic. Not usable in response to other counterattack Charms; grants no free/extra parry dice.

name: Fluttering Moth Defense
description: The weapon dances to intercept attacks like a moth about a torch: rolls full Dexterity + Melee to parry any one close-range attack the Abyssal is aware of.

name: Corrosive Parry
description: Fills the blade with necrotic Essence to rot the opponent's weapon to dust as it strikes his block: roll Dexterity + Melee vs any close attack; even one success shatters the attacker's weapon without injuring the defender. Costs motes equal to the weapon's base damage modifier + 1. Only actual weapons (not fists/claws), never Essence weapons or the Five Magical Materials.

name: Hundred Razor Circle
description: Stands motionless tracing a warded circle of strikes: he cannot actively attack, dodge, or move faster than one yard per turn without breaking the Charm, but automatically rolls a full Dexterity + Melee attack against everyone within (or who approaches within) three yards. May also reflexively swat aside incoming projectiles (difficulty 4 Dexterity + Melee + Parry). Does not distinguish friend from foe.

name: Attunement-Shattering Block
description: Dissipates the Essence empowering a magical weapon parried, rendering it temporarily useless: on at least one parry success, the defender rolls Essence + Melee vs the weapon-wielder's permanent Essence; success makes the weapon an inert hunk until reattuned (15-30 min). The victim can avert deattunement by immediately paying the weapon's attunement cost.

name: Incomparable Sentinel Stance
description: Effortlessly deflects any attack she is aware of without a roll, including assaults normally impossible to parry (caustic slime, falling boulders) and the attacks of greater spirits and demon lords. Non-magical weapons used against her shatter. A perfect defense.

name: Eye of the Tempest
description: Becomes a point of serene calm in a vortex of steel and shadow: the player may use full Dexterity + Melee to parry all physical attacks of which the Abyssal is aware.
